text:
mika: FYI planning a staggered unpin of runtime 2.14 -> 3.0 for canary traffic tonight 21:30 PT. We found model-specific regressions on quant-longseq paths in eu-central when runtime 3.0 handles KV cache warmups. Proposing: region-scoped model pin + incremental traffic ramp for canary cohort. Thoughts?

jonah: What does the regression look like in metrics? latency spike or error rate?

mika: Mainly p95 latency spikes (+40%) and occasional OOM/5xx during first few hundred requests after instance spin-up. Not steady errors.

sasha: I like region-scoped model pin. Also suggest a 5% canary cohort weight for 30m then 25/50/100 if healthy. Avoid full runtime pin unless we see sustained errors.

pratik: Agree on ramp. Also recommend pinning affected model variant (quant-v4b-longseq-stable) in eu-central for 24h as a fallback instead of pinning runtime. That keeps other models on 3.0.

ivy: I uploaded detailed flamegraphs and a short analysis: s3://redwood-debug/3311112222/flame.tgz. Warmup allocations point to attention kernel path differences in 3.0.

mika: Good. DevX, can you craft a tiny advisory for customers in eu-central + enterprise-svcs? Keep it terse, link to status page.

devx: On it. Draft: "We're running a cautious canary for runtime 3.0. Some quant long-seq models in eu-central are pinned to a stable variant while we validate KV-cache warmup behavior. No customer data is affected. See status.redwood.ai/3311112222 for updates." Will post in #release-notes once we confirm ramp plan.

mika: deploybot, apply model pin in eu-central for quant-v4b-longseq-stable TTL=24h, initiator=mika.

deploybot: Running:
```
/deploy pin model quant-v4b-longseq-stable --region eu-central --ttl 24h --initiator=mika
```

deploybot: Done. pin-id=pin-3311112222-ec. Audit: https://audit.redwood.ai/pins/pin-3311112222-ec

riley: I've scheduled a controlled traffic ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m waits and automatic rollback at any of the checkpoints if p95 > baseline * 1.3 or 5xx rate rises by >0.5%.

jonah: I'll watch canary dashboards and heap/trace noise. Tagging traces with tag: canary:33111 so we can filter.

sasha: Runbook escalation: if errors persist after model pin & ramp fails -> soft rollback runtime in eu-central to 2.14 for canary cohort only. pratik to own execution.

pratik: Confirmed I will perform runtime rollback if triggered. Rollback command ready in ops runbook: 
```
/deploy rollback runtime 3.0 --region eu-central --cohort canary --reason "canary kv-warmup regression"
```
Note: rollback will preserve model metadata and only switch runtime image for the cohort.

mika: Also lock SDK callers in the canary cohort to SDK 1.7.3 to avoid new batching opt-in changes introduced in 1.8.x. We'll surface that in the advisory.

devx: Advisory updated with SDK note. Posting to #release-notes and emailing enterprise-svcs.

jonah: Canary at 5% now. p95 elevated by 12% but within threshold, no 5xx increase. Monitoring.

ivy: Flamegraphs show warmup CPI on the attention kernel at first few token batches; appears transient.

riley: After 30m ramp -> 25% checkpoint: p95 normalized, no 5xx. Proceeding to 50%.

jonah: 50% stable. No OOMs in the canary instances.

sasha: Move to full rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC if no regressions. Otherwise we keep model pins active until engineers complete kernel tune.

deploybot: Scheduled unpin event created: 
```
/deploy schedule-unpin pin-id=pin-3311112222-ec --at 3311203600 --initiator=mika
```
unpin-id=unpin-3311112222-ec.

pratik: If we need to rollback, capture a runtime snapshot first: 
```
/deploy snapshot runtime 3.0 --region eu-central --tag canary-331111
```
Upload location will be posted before rollback command is executed.

mika: Thanks team. Posting short updates here only: GO/WAIT/ROLLBACK. Leaving pin active until scheduled unpin. I'll notify enterprise-svcs and update the release board.

jonah: GO -> canary passed 3 checkpoints.

pratik: Holding rollback command in case.

mika: closing thread for now; reopen if anything changes.
